title: Two neighbouring arguments cannot both be whitelisted

source.licenceUse: The repository is fetched at run time at the pinned commit and never committed here. finding.json, report.md and poc.patch are Verdikta's own words and code, as are the prior findings and known issues beside them.
source.adaptedHow: A test of our own, written from the finding's description, that asserts what the hunter says should hold, so it fails while the behaviour is present. The finding's test expects the revert, on two ranges of two bytes; this one whitelists the two arguments of a lending deposit and states what should happen. The upstream fix makes endIndex inclusive, so on the fix the same test passes with its ends one lower.
